_note: Faceless story channels. Every video is fiction, says so on screen and in the caption, and is posted with the platform's AI-generated label. Keep ids in sync with analytics-dashboard/lib/channels/registry.ts.
negative_prompt: text, letters, words, screen, phone screen, sign, face, faces, portrait, person looking at camera, eyes, nudity, cleavage, lingerie, gore, text, watermark, logo, stock photo, bright, cheerful, low quality, blurry
image_style: cinematic, moody, faceless, shallow depth of field, 35mm film grain, night tones, 9:16 vertical, no visible faces

the-verdict.name: The Verdict

formats.dilemma: A first-person fictional relationship or friendship dilemma. Both people have a real point. Lay out what happened in order, then the moment it blew up.
formats.two-sides: Tell the same fictional fight twice: first from one person's side, then the other's. The second version should reframe the first.
formats.update: A fictional follow-up to an earlier dilemma: what happened after, with one twist the audience didn't see coming.

the-verdict.ending: End by asking the viewer directly who was wrong, with two clear options they can type in the comments.

petty-revenge.name: Petty Revenge

formats.storytime: A fictional petty-revenge story: someone is wronged in a small, relatable way (coworker, landlord, neighbor, ex) and gets back at them cleverly and legally.
formats.karma: A fictional story where someone's own bad behavior catches up with them without the narrator lifting a finger.
formats.serial: Part one of a fictional multi-part revenge story. Set up the wrong and the plan, and stop right before the payoff.

petty-revenge.ending: Land the payoff in one short line. For serials, end on the cliffhanger and say part 2 is coming.

hooks.question: Open with a direct question to the viewer.
hooks.cold-open: Open mid-scene at the most tense moment, then rewind.
hooks.verdict-bait: Open by saying the internet is split on this one.
hooks.cliffhanger: Open by teasing the ending without revealing it.
hooks.statement: Open with one blunt, surprising statement.
